title: Completed tower complexes admit K-injective resolutions
statement: For the completed coefficient tower and any scheme morphism f, structural map c and tower complex I occurring in the completed tower pushforward argument, there exist a K-injective target tower complex T and a quasi-isomorphism from the levelwise pushforward of I to T.

proof.text: Put B = Mod Y (R l E Y) and w = max u (t+1). Apply SheafOfModules.isGrothendieckAbelianOfUniverses to the original pro-etale site and the completed ring sheaf. The common universe is w; neither the site nor the ring is replaced. Choose its separator G.
The tower category has pointwise abelianness, filtered colimits and exact filtered colimits, using the functor-category instances. Thus it satisfies HasFilteredColimitsOfSize and AB5OfSize in w.

For each n in the opposite natural-number category, let L_n be the left adjoint of evaluation at n. The family L_n(G) separates towers: if a and b agree after every map from these objects, adjunction says their nth components agree after every map from G. Since G is a separator, those components agree. Natural transformation extensionality gives a=b. ObjectProperty.IsSeparating.isSeparator_coproduct makes the coproduct of this countable family a separator. This proves the tower category is Grothendieck abelian.

The pushforward functor is additive, so postcomposition on towers preserves zero morphisms and defines its functor on cochain complexes. Apply HasKInjectiveResolutions.exists_isKInjective, supplied by the existing Grothendieck K-injective resolution instance, to the levelwise pushforward of I. It returns T, its K-injectivity, a monomorphic quasi-isomorphism j. Forget monicity and reorder the witnesses to obtain precisely the unchanged conclusion.

proof_origin.place: Tag 079Q (remark-existence-D), the ringed-site example, and the small-diagram generator argument of lem-weil-pbc-small-module-diagrams-grothendieck; the existing source-library K-injective resolution theorem lem-sfb-grothendieck-k-injective. F6 specializes the evaluation-adjoint proof to natural-number towers while retaining independent site and ring universes.

lean.statement: theorem completedTower_exists_isKInjective {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (c : R l E Y ⟶ (ringPush.{t, u} f).obj (R l E X)) (I : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Mod X (R l E X)) ℤ) : ∃ (T : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Mod Y (R l E Y)) ℤ) (j : ((((Functor.whiskeringRight ℕᵒᵖ _ _).obj (push f c)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I) ⟶ T), T.IsKInjective ∧ QuasiIso j
